key_findings.finding: The ORD search found exact aryl bromide and boronic-acid reactants, but returned the records with solvent CO (SMILES for methanol), not the queried THF or DMF. In the returned ten records, isolated/reported yields are 78.1%, 77.4%, 76.5%, 76.3%, 76.2%, 75.8%, 75.1%, 74.2%, 73.7%, and 73.2%; all list 100 °C and 5.00 h. The records vary in catalyst/additive/base, so this is not a controlled solvent-only comparison.

source_tools.relevance: Exact reactant-match ORD search and returned solvent, yield, time, temperature, catalyst, and reagent details

key_findings.finding: The highest-yield returned record is ord-cb757624c570427b958145f6422ac50e at 78.1%; it uses methanol (CO), a cyclohexyl-substituted phosphine, palladium acetate, and cesium carbonate—not triphenylphosphine/KOH. A second methanol record, ord-915547390fa846db9a944e76ada7ebf1, reports 76.3% with triphenylphosphine, palladium acetate, and KOH. No THF or DMF records were returned in this result set, so it does not establish a comparative winner among all three solvents under otherwise identical conditions.

source_tools.relevance: Specific highest-yield record plus the matching triphenylphosphine/KOH methanol record; absence of THF/DMF in retrieved set
